scripts.download:win: docker run -it -v %cd%:/tmp ngearing/git-ftp /bin/bash -c "git reset --hard && git ftp download"
scripts.download:unix: docker run -it -v $(pwd):/tmp ngearing/git-ftp /bin/bash -c "git reset --hard && git ftp download"
scripts.push:win: docker run -it -v %cd%:/tmp ngearing/git-ftp /bin/bash -c "git reset --hard && git ftp push"
scripts.push:unix: docker run -it -v $(pwd):/tmp ngearing/git-ftp /bin/bash -c "git reset --hard && git ftp push"
